linkedin.text:
There's a version of event production that looks effortless on the day.

It only looks that way because of what happened in the 72 hours before.

Here's what that window actually involves on a UPE production:
— Full venue walk with technical director and show caller
— AV cue-to-cue rehearsal, every transition
— Furniture and staging repositioned until sightlines clear every seat
— Contingency run: what breaks, who calls it, what replaces it
— Complete show flow, start to finish, run twice

After 1,500+ events across 130+ destinations, we've seen what a skipped step costs. So we don't skip steps.

If you're a senior HR, marketing or sales leader planning a major corporate event and want to understand what a production that's actually been stress-tested looks like — I'm happy to walk you through it. Comment or DM.
